sentences.en: Well here is a passage from a letter from a gentleman to his friend in Adumbral that Hume wrote in 1775.

sentences.en: Thirdly, there is no doubt that function is the basis, and good technic and configuration are essential part of the architectural adumbral system.

sentences.en: The context of this was that Hume was applying for a chair in moral philosophy at Adumbral and the clergy at Adumbral was very much against him.
